limits: David Ames's SQL, request options and partition layout are unknown; this is a controlled SDK comparison, not full replication.

Query-dependent ranking, source isolation and cross-client/route agreement are separate from exact hybrid order and semantic recall; neither agreement nor distinctness alone proves exact hybrid correctness.
Exact vector references merge all eight full-document partitions using brute force; descending cosine similarity and cutoff ties are explicitly handled.
Visible data-range contacts are positive evidence; missing range headers mean unknown scope, never zero fan-out. A single-range target cannot prove improved large-container routing efficiency.
Known wire RU includes captured charges only. SDK page RU overlaps wire RU and must not be added. Missing charges and total billed RU remain unknown.
Matched throttle retries are zero; SDK metadata refresh/query-plan fallback is not an application retry. Other SDK-native internal retry paths can differ and total retries remain null.

Gateway, one logical query at a time and bounded connection/page controls are fixed. Instrumented latency includes diagnostics capture and SDK runtime differences; no production latency or concurrency claim.

Small-corpus index engagement is not assumed. No account/container provisioning, application deployment/default change, representation change, model call or data mutation is performed by this harness.
